subcategory_text: Third parties (e.g., service providers, customers, partners) understand their roles and responsibilities.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SR-5 (Acquisition Strategies), SR-6 (Supplier Assessments and Reviews)
implementation_examples: Provide third parties (service providers, customers, partners) with the privacy awareness they need to meet their contractual obligations
Include privacy-awareness obligations in onboarding and refresh training expectations on a defined cadence
Use tabletop exercises to validate third-party readiness
assessment_objectives: Determine whether third parties are informed of their privacy roles and responsibilities
Determine whether awareness obligations are embedded in contracts
Determine whether third-party awareness is refreshed on a cadence
Determine whether third-party awareness is tested
